programme.desc: James Martin demonstrates the classic technique for preparing and cooking scallops. Plus, he is joined by chef Martin Blunos to cook cod in beer batter. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Spice Up Your Life. Nigel uses one of his favourite spices to cook mustard and lemon sausages with carrot mash. Plus, he makes a refreshing jelly for grown-ups. S2, Ep3

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Too Good To Waste. Nigel makes the most of what's leftover in his fridge by whipping up cheese and thyme puddings. Plus, he cooks crisp herb mushrooms. S2, Ep4

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Breakfast On The Run. Ree whips up grab-and-go breakfasts for the family. She bakes individual ham casseroles and a baked oatmeal served with fruit kebabs and blueberry yoghurt dip. S16, Ep11

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Driving Fence Posts. Ree's family are all working together on the ranch. She makes them steak sandwiches with grilled onions and fried eggs. Plus, mini pecan pies to end the meal. S16, Ep12

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.desc: Fish Baps And Mushroom Farfalle. Jamie makes his best fish baps, mushy peas and tartare sauce. Later he cooks mushroom farfalle with blue cheese and a hazelnut and apple salad. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Jamie's 15 Minute Meals
programme.desc: Lamb Lollipops And Prawn Linguini. Jamie cooks lamb lollipops, curry sauce and rice and peas. Plus, prawn linguini and Sicilian shaved fennel salad. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Weeknight Dinners. Ina Garten focuses on comforting weeknight dinners. They include all-in-one skillet-roasted chicken and potatoes and seared salmon with spicy red pepper aioli. S19, Ep1

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Simple Pleasures. Ina Garten makes the dishes that bring her joy. Her delicious menu includes giant crinkled chocolate chip cookies and cheddar and chutney grilled cheese. S19, Ep2

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: It's Dessert Week and the bakers tackle a miniature cheesecake signature. They face a 17th century technical and a showstopping jelly art dessert cake. S11, Ep8

programme.title: Classic Mary Berry
programme.desc: Mary shares her delicious but simple recipes and meets a traditional farmer. She takes on classic British dishes like prawn cocktail, onion soup and banoffee pie. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Paul Hollywood City Bakes
programme.desc: Jerusalem. Paul Hollywood is in Jerusalem where he learns about the city's baking culture and history. He then creates Jerusalem bagel bread and almond and pomegranate loaf cake. S2, Ep9

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen. Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen drops in for lunch, and Prue shares her recipe for peppercorn-infused chocolate cake. Plus, tips for perfect homemade pizza. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Homestyle. Guy Fieri stops in at eateries serving home cooking. In Arizona, a musician prepares the recipes he learned living in Italy. In New Mexico a diner serves corned beef hash. S6, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: All Kinds Of Classics. Guy Fieri checks out classics across the US, beginning in Fort Worth and ending in Miami. And, actor Martin Sheen samples steak at a spicy roadside joint! S6, Ep9
